hooks.command:
input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"pnpm dev:designer"*|*"pnpm dev:minimal"*|*"pnpm dev:client"*|*"pnpm dev:admin"*|*"pnpm dev:frontend"*) env_file="apps/designer-portal/.env.local"; missing=""; if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then missing=" (file missing)"; else grep -q '^NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY=phc_' "$env_file" || missing="$missing NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY"; grep -q '^NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST=' "$env_file" || missing="$missing NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST"; grep -q '^NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_ENABLE_IN_DEV=true' "$env_file" || missing="$missing NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_ENABLE_IN_DEV=true"; fi; if [ -n "$missing" ]; then jq -nc --arg m "$missing" '{systemMessage: ("PostHog dev env not set — feature flags will fail-closed locally. Missing:" + $m), hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", additionalContext: ("apps/designer-portal/.env.local is missing PostHog vars for local dev (missing:" + $m + "). Feature flags (procurement-workspace-pilot) will evaluate to false; gated UI is invisible. Add to apps/designer-portal/.env.local before running dev:
NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY=<phc_... from PostHog project 326191>
NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST=https://us.i.posthog.com
NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_ENABLE_IN_DEV=true")}}'; fi ;; esac; exit 0
